# KARADAVI — The Knowledge Forest

> Connected, evidence-aware knowledge with human editorial authority.

KARADAVI is a knowledge platform for exploring people, companies, technology, science, space, concepts, history, places, nature and earth, and society and culture through the relationships between them.

## Core idea

Every page is a starting point. Every connection leads somewhere.

KARADAVI treats knowledge as a connected forest rather than a collection of isolated pages. Entities establish subjects. Relationships form trails. Claims, evidence, provenance, authority, and uncertainty preserve context.

## Knowledge domains

People · Companies · Technology · Science · Space · Concepts · History · Places · Nature & Earth · Society & Culture

These are discovery entrances rather than hard ontological boundaries.

## Public principles

- Connected knowledge over isolated facts.
- Provenance over opaque assertion.
- Uncertainty over false precision.
- Context over universal rankings.
- Human publication authority.
- Trails over dead ends.

## Editorial principle

Knowledge is automatic. Writing is intentional. Publishing is human.

AI and software may assist research, organization, extraction, relationship discovery, and writing. They do not receive publication authority.

## Public knowledge model

Entity → Claim → Evidence → Provenance + Authority + Uncertainty → Evaluation

Entity → Relationship → Entity

The model is experimental and intended to keep important distinctions inspectable.

## Public repository

This repository explains KARADAVI's public ideas, philosophy, knowledge model, editorial principles, research, terminology, and experimental specifications.

It is not a source-code mirror or public engineering-status dashboard.

## Status

KARADAVI is an evolving knowledge platform and active public research project. Public schemas and terminology are experimental and may change as the ideas are tested.
